entries.english: This photo could not load. Close and try again when connected.
entries.zu: Lesi sithombe asikwazanga ukulayishwa. Vala bese uzama futhi uma usuxhumekile.
entries.st: Setshwantsho sena ha se a kgona ho kena. Kwala mme o leke hape ha o hokahane.
entries.ts: Xifaniso lexi a xi kotanga ku layicha. Pfala kutani u ringeta nakambe loko u hlanganisiwile.
entries.ve: Tshifanyiso itshi a tsho ngo konadzea u laisiwa. Valani ni lingedze hafhu musi no ṱumanywa.

scope: Global opted-in photo viewer controls, accessibility, illustration marker and load error. Original photograph source and owned caption remain verbatim. No new photographs, uploads or farming claims.

releasePairs.english: Photo viewer controls now have four draft translations.
releasePairs.zu: Izinkinobho zesibukeli sezithombe manje zinokuhumusha okusaluhlaka ngezilimi ezine.
releasePairs.st: Ditaolo tsa sebohi sa ditshwantsho jwale di na le diphetolelo tsa moralo ka dipuo tse nne.
releasePairs.ts: Swilawuri swa xilanguti xa swifaniso sweswi swi ni vuhundzuluxi bya mpfapfarhuto hi tindzimi ta mune.
releasePairs.ve: Zwilangi zwa tshivhoni tsha zwifanyiso zwino zwi na ṱhalutshedzelo dza mvetamveto nga nyambo nṋa.

releasePairs.english: If your account has a photograph, open it. The photo viewer controls use your language; the original caption stays as recorded.
releasePairs.zu: Uma i-akhawunti yakho inesithombe, sivule. Izinkinobho zesibukeli sezithombe zisebenzisa ulimi lwakho; umbhalo wesithombe wokuqala uhlala njengoba uqoshiwe.
releasePairs.st: Haeba akhaonto ya hao e na le setshwantsho, se bule. Ditaolo tsa sebohi sa ditshwantsho di sebedisa puo ya hao; mongolo wa pele wa setshwantsho o sala o le jwalo ka ha o ngotswe.
releasePairs.ts: Loko akhawunti ya wena yi ri ni xifaniso, xi pfule. Swilawuri swa xilanguti xa swifaniso swi tirhisa ririmi ra wena; nhlamuselo yo sungula ya xifaniso yi sala yi ri leswi yi tsariweke swona.
releasePairs.ve: Arali akhaunthu yaṋu i na tshifanyiso, tshi vuleni. Zwilangi zwa tshivhoni tsha zwifanyiso zwi shumisa luambo lwaṋu; ṱhaluso ya u thoma ya tshifanyiso i sala nga nḓila ye ya ṅwalwa ngayo.

guideNote: The new optional Account photo stop keeps two visible stops when the older Updates stop leaves the five-note window; original sharing stop remains. No photo is invented when Account has none.
